tagline: Supporting entrepreneurs and families by providing patient capital and expertise for growth
hero_kpi_rationale: Equity is the primary value indicator for an investment company like Sofina, reflecting the size and trajectory of its long-term investment portfolio.

kpis.name: Equity
kpis.explanation: Total value of the investment company's net assets.
kpis.description: Equity reaches €7.63 billion in 2019, driven by strong investment performance.

kpis.name: Total Shareholder Return
kpis.explanation: Total shareholder performance including share price and dividends.
kpis.description: TSR reaches 18.4% in 2019, outperforming the MSCI ACWI index over 7 years with a 12.9% return versus 12.3% for the index.

kpis.name: Investment allocation by sector
kpis.explanation: Proportion of equity invested in each target sector.
kpis.description: 43% of equity invested in consumer goods and services, followed by digital transformation (31%), education (20%), and healthcare.
kpis.signal: Dominant weight of consumer goods and services

kpis.name: Number of investment professionals
kpis.explanation: Number of employees specialized in investing.
kpis.description: 26 investment professionals based in Brussels, Luxembourg, and Singapore, with 11 new hires in 2019 representing nearly 20% of total staff.

kpis.name: Geographic presence
kpis.explanation: Geographic regions where the company operates through its offices.
kpis.description: Offices in Brussels, Luxembourg, and Singapore, with over half of the portfolio invested outside Europe.
kpis.signal: Global coverage across Europe, Asia, and North America

risks.title: Investment selection and monitoring risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked #7 in the matrix (investment process) with medium-high impact/probability. Specific language: "investment misalignment with strategic objectives, poor data analysis." Sofina critically depends on the quality of its investment selection and monitoring process to create value.

risks.title: Premature or non-compliant divestment risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk #8 in the matrix (divestment process) with medium impact. Explicit language: "failure to divest at the right time resulting in loss or opportunity cost" and "exit without complying with laws and regulations." Sofina deepened this risk assessment in 2018.

risks.title: Conflict of interest risk with minority shareholders
risks.score_rationale: Risk #11 in the matrix (minority stake) with medium impact. Sofina primarily invests as a minority shareholder; its rights or vision may diverge from those of the majority shareholder. Structural risk inherent to the investment model.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT infrastructure risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk #22 in the matrix (cybersecurity and IT), classified as a 2019 internal audit priority. Intensive language: "cyber threats represent a major operational risk." Sofina launched Office 365 deployments and enhanced objectivity through Duff & Phelps. Risk trending upward with geographic and sectoral expansion.

risks.title: Key personnel loss and talent management risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk #23 in the matrix (loss of key individuals), assessed in depth in 2018. Explicit language: "Sofina must recruit, retain, and develop its human capital." Sofina is a small organization (limited staff); the loss of critical talent directly impacts strategy and execution capacity.

risks.title: Regulatory and legal non-compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: Risks #28, #30, #31 in the matrix (legal compliance, anticipation of legislative framework, framework evolution). Specific language: "risk of non-compliance through action or omission." GDPR was assessed in depth in 2019. Sofina operates in a continuously evolving regulatory environment (Europe, United States, Asia).

risks.title: Portfolio lack of diversification or poor selection risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk #5 in the matrix (portfolio) with medium impact. Language: "lack of diversification or systematic poor selection." Sofina aims to maintain portfolio diversification; excessive concentration or flawed selection increases risk concentration.

risks.title: Reputational risk and third-party actions/inactions
risks.score_rationale: Risks #4 and #32 in the matrix (reputation, third-party actions/inactions). Language: "legal and reputational risk that Sofina incurs due to actions or inactions of third parties (primarily portfolio companies)." Sofina deepened this risk in 2018.
